# summarySCI

Welcome to the Git repository of the package `summarySCI`.

## Installation

You can install the package from the main branch using

    pak::pak("SAKK-Statistics/summarySCI")

You can install the package from another branch using

    pak::pak("SAKK-Statistics/summarySCI@branchname", dependencies = TRUE)

## Functions

Currently, the package contains three functions:

- [`summaryTable()`](https://sakk-statistics.github.io/summarySCI/reference/summaryTable.md)
- [`summaryLevels()`](https://sakk-statistics.github.io/summarySCI/reference/summaryLevels.md)
- [`summaryByVisit()`](https://sakk-statistics.github.io/summarySCI/reference/summaryByVisit.md)
- [`boxplotSCI()`](https://sakk-statistics.github.io/summarySCI/reference/boxplotSCI.md)

# Package index

## All functions

- [`boxplotSCI()`](https://sakk-statistics.github.io/summarySCI/reference/boxplotSCI.md)
  : Boxplot over time

- [`hemoglobin_data`](https://sakk-statistics.github.io/summarySCI/reference/hemoglobin_data.md)
  :

  Hemoglobin data (to illustrate
  [`boxplotSCI()`](https://sakk-statistics.github.io/summarySCI/reference/boxplotSCI.md)
  and
  [`summaryByVisit()`](https://sakk-statistics.github.io/summarySCI/reference/summaryByVisit.md))

- [`lineplotSCI()`](https://sakk-statistics.github.io/summarySCI/reference/lineplotSCI.md)
  : Line plot of a summary statistic over time, by group

- [`plotByVisit()`](https://sakk-statistics.github.io/summarySCI/reference/plotByVisit.md)
  : Plot a summaryByVisit table

- [`save_plot()`](https://sakk-statistics.github.io/summarySCI/reference/save_plot.md)
  : Save a plot to a file

- [`save_plots()`](https://sakk-statistics.github.io/summarySCI/reference/save_plots.md)
  : Save plots to files

- [`print(`*`<sci_plot>`*`)`](https://sakk-statistics.github.io/summarySCI/reference/sci_plot.md)
  [`plot(`*`<sci_plot>`*`)`](https://sakk-statistics.github.io/summarySCI/reference/sci_plot.md)
  : Plot objects

- [`stackedbarplotSCI()`](https://sakk-statistics.github.io/summarySCI/reference/stackedbarplotSCI.md)
  : Stacked barplot over time

- [`summarizeByVisitSCI()`](https://sakk-statistics.github.io/summarySCI/reference/summarizeByVisitSCI.md)
  : Summarize data by visit as a table and plots

- [`summarizeSCI()`](https://sakk-statistics.github.io/summarySCI/reference/summarizeSCI.md)
  : Summarize data as a table and plots

- [`summaryByVisit()`](https://sakk-statistics.github.io/summarySCI/reference/summaryByVisit.md)
  : Creates publication-ready summary tables for data grouped, by visit

- [`summaryByVisitCategorical()`](https://sakk-statistics.github.io/summarySCI/reference/summaryByVisitCategorical.md)
  : Creates publication-ready summary tables for categorical data
  grouped, by visit

- [`summaryByVisitContinuous()`](https://sakk-statistics.github.io/summarySCI/reference/summaryByVisitContinuous.md)
  : Creates publication-ready summary tables for continuous data
  grouped, by visit

- [`summaryLevels()`](https://sakk-statistics.github.io/summarySCI/reference/summaryLevels.md)
  : summaryLevels

- [`summaryTable()`](https://sakk-statistics.github.io/summarySCI/reference/summaryTable.md)
  : Creates publication-ready summary tables

- [`tidySummaryByVisit()`](https://sakk-statistics.github.io/summarySCI/reference/tidySummaryByVisit.md)
  : Read the numbers off a summaryByVisit table
